description: This file defines the code-behind class for the StartExam page in an online examination system. It handles user session validation, dynamic course loading based on student semester, starting theory or MCQ exams, navigation to other pages, and checking if a student has already taken an exam.
external_methods: Session[] (indexing to store and retrieve session variables)

classes.name: StartExam
